idea.title: UGC agency matching small DTC brands with video creators

source.text: A UGC agency that connects small DTC brands with creators who film product videos, 20% commission. Launch country US, budget $1,000, 15 hours a week, goal side income, no special edge. Just go: do not ask questions.

idea.solution: An agency that connects small DTC brands with creators who film product videos
assumptions: Price is a 20% commission on the creator fee, billed to the brand on top of the creator rate
Typical order is a pack of 5 videos at the 2025 Collabstr average paid price of $154 per video
The user's time is valued at $25/hour (estimate) to cost CAC and per-order support
First customers come from cold email/DMs to Shopify brands that run paid social ads
The problem is stated by the reviewer: small DTC brands need a steady flow of ad-ready creator videos

confidence.note: CAC, lifetime and support hours are estimates; 10 real cold emails and 1 delivered order would replace them

gross_margin.note: About 34% after Stripe fees and ~3 h briefing/revisions per order at $25/h (estimate); R5 costs_eat_margin caps at 2

ltv_cac.note: LTV ~$156 vs CAC ~$170 (estimate): ratio ~0.9, under 1; R4 applies

pricing_power.note: 20% fee vs Collabstr 10% (5% Premium) and TikTok One at no platform fee: price is set below yours

build_effort.note: Manual service: a one-page offer, a creator list and an invoice; testable in under a week

skills_match.note: Needs B2B sales, creative briefing and ad know-how; user states no edge, all learnable

capital_needed.note: Domain, email tool and site fit well inside the $1,000 budget; creators paid from client funds

time_to_mvp.note: Offer live in days; creators recruitable from Fiverr and communities

sales_cycle.note: Founder-led DTC brands decide in 1-4 weeks; small first orders ($770-$925)

channel_readiness.note: Cold email exists but reply rates are 0.45-3.43%; user has no audience

search_demand.note: Active buyer market: Collabstr data covers 21,000+ collaborations in 2025

trend.note: Brands shift budget to UGC, but average price fell 44% vs 2024: volume up, value flat

willingness_to_pay.note: Brands pay $99-$185 per video today, with AI options at ~$11 pulling it down

free_alternatives.note: TikTok One lets brands find and invite creators at no platform fee; R1 caps at 1.5

competitor_density.note: 20+ direct players: Billo, Insense, Collabstr, JoinBrands, Fiverr, plus AI tools

differentiation.note: No edge stated; 'we match brands and creators' is the default offer; R1 applies

legal_regulatory.note: FTC 2023 Endorsement Guides, usage-rights contracts and 1099 creators: compliance work

platform_dependency.note: Videos run on Meta/TikTok ads, but the agency itself is not tied to one platform

market_risk.note: AI UGC at ~$11/video threatens the low end the agency would serve

skills.note: No stated marketing, sales or creator-management track record

assets.note: No audience, brand network or creator roster stated

interest.note: Goal stated as side income; no domain passion stated

rules_applied.effect: competition 1.67 -> 1.17 (free_alternatives 2 -> 1, differentiation 2 -> 1.5): TikTok One is free, user has no edge
LTV:CAC 0.92; profit held at 1.5, under the 2 cap (ltv_cac 2 -> 1)

tam.reasoning: Global UGC platform market $7.1B (Fortune Business Insights, 2025) x North America share 33.3% = $2.36B; SNS Insider puts global at $9.0B

sam.reasoning: 993,399 live US Shopify stores x 5% buying creator UGC x $2,000/yr creator spend = $99M; x 20% commission = ~$20M agency-revenue pool

som.reasoning: 0.1% of the $20M SAM for a solo founder at 15 h/week = $20,000 commission revenue/year

price.reasoning: 5 videos x $154 avg paid price (Collabstr 2025 data) x 20% commission = $154 per order

variable_cost_per_unit.reasoning: Stripe 2.9% + $0.30 on $924 gross billing = $27.1, plus 3 h briefing/revisions x $25/h = $75; total ~$102

churn_monthly_pct.reasoning: Assumes 3 orders per brand before it buys direct from the creator or switches: 1 / 3 orders = 33% monthly churn at 1 order/month

expected_lifetime.reasoning: Assumption: 3 orders before disintermediation; brands meet the creator and can rehire them directly

conversion_rate_pct.reasoning: 3.43% reply rate (Instantly) x 10% of replies closing = 0.34% of emails sent

payback_months.reasoning: $170 CAC / $52 contribution per month (1 order/month) = 3.3 months, longer than the 3-order lifetime

fixed_costs_month.reasoning: Domain + Google Workspace + cold email tool + site builder, about $60/month

time_to_first_revenue_weeks.reasoning: 1 week setup + 2-3 weeks outreach at 0.34% conversion + 1 week first delivery

verdict.launch_reason: The user chose the US; it holds the largest UGC buyer base (North America 33.3% of the UGC platform market).
verdict.cheapest_test: Pitch 100 Shopify skincare/supplement brands a $1,250 flat 5-video package with a free hook teardown; target 3+ positive replies and 1 deposit in 7 days
kill_criteria: Fewer than 3 positive replies from 100 personalised emails by day 7 -> stop
Delivering one order takes more than 6 hours of your time -> raise the price or stop

rescue.change: Sell a fixed-price niche package instead of a commission: 5 ad-ready videos with 3 hooks each for Shopify skincare/supplement brands, $1,250 flat
rescue.why: Fixes pricing_power and ltv_cac: ~$500 gross per order vs $154, and editing/hooks differentiate from free matching
rescue.effort: 1-2 weeks to set up the offer and 5 creators
rescue.requires: Basic video editing (CapCut) and reading Meta ad performance

rescue.change: Monthly creative-testing retainer: 8 creator videos plus hook variants for brands spending on Meta ads, $1,500/month
rescue.why: Fixes churn and ltv_cac: recurring revenue replaces one-off orders that end in disintermediation
rescue.effort: 2-3 months to prove results on 1-2 brands
rescue.requires: Paid social performance skills the user does not have yet

narrative.answer: PIVOT. Matchmaking for a **20% commission** loses money: TikTok One matches brands and creators for free, Collabstr charges 10%, and each client is worth less than they cost to win (**LTV:CAC 0.9**). A fixed-price, niche video package could work.
tldr: Brands can find creators for free on TikTok One, or pay 10% on Collabstr; a **20% middleman fee** has no pricing power.
Each order earns about **$154**, and roughly a third of that is left after fees and 3 hours of work; clients go direct to creators after a few orders.
Rescue: sell a **flat $1,250** niche package with editing and hooks, not an introduction.

key_findings.title: Matching is free elsewhere
key_findings.detail: TikTok One lets brands browse and invite creators at **no platform fee**, and Collabstr charges 10% (5% on Premium).

key_findings.title: Clients cost more than they return
key_findings.detail: At a **3.43%** cold-email reply rate, CAC is ~$170 against ~$156 lifetime contribution (estimate): LTV:CAC **0.92**.

key_findings.title: Video prices are falling fast
key_findings.detail: Average UGC price fell **44%** vs 2024, and AI tools make an ad for about **$11**.

narrative.recommendation: Do not launch a commission matchmaking agency. Test a **flat $1,250 niche package** (5 videos, 3 hooks each) for Shopify skincare brands this week, and stop if 100 emails bring fewer than 3 replies.
narrative.steelman: Brands keep moving budget to UGC (Collabstr 2025 data, 21,000+ collaborations), the service needs no code and under $1,000, and small brands want someone to handle briefs, revisions and quality. The evidence supports demand, but not a 20% fee for the introduction alone.

premortem.cause: Brands found creators themselves on TikTok One or Collabstr and refused a 20% fee on top
premortem.early_signal: More than half of replies ask why not hire the creator directly

premortem.cause: Each client cost more hours to win and serve than the commission paid
premortem.early_signal: Fewer than 2 replies per 100 emails, or over 4 hours per order

premortem.cause: Clients rehired the same creators directly after 1-2 orders
premortem.early_signal: First client does not reorder within 30 days

changes.what: TikTok folded Creator Marketplace into **TikTok One**, a free way for brands to reach creators
AI UGC tools (Arcads, MakeUGC) produce ad videos for about **$7-$12** each
Average UGC creator price fell **44%** from 2024 levels
Brands shifted budget from TikTok influencer campaigns to **UGC**

why_now.note: Demand for UGC is real, but free matching and AI video are compressing the middleman's margin.

icp.who: US Shopify skincare/supplement brands running Meta or TikTok ads that need 5-10 new creator videos a month
where: Shopify app review pages for UGC apps
icp.pays_for_today: Billo from $99/video; Collabstr creators at $154 avg paid plus a 10% fee; Insense from $400/month
icp.budget: unknown; a 5-video pack at market rates is $500-$925
icp.trigger: Launching a new product, or current ads wearing out and needing new hooks

free_alternative.evidence: TikTok One lets brands discover and invite creators with **no platform fee**; JoinBrands has a $0 plan.

strong_competitor.evidence: Billo ($99/video), Insense ($400/month), Collabstr (10% fee) and JoinBrands all serve this exact buyer.

graveyard.evidence: Bounty, a pay-per-UGC TikTok video company, **shut down**; the autopsy names unstable CAC.

no_distribution.evidence: Cold email to DTC founders works but is weak: **0.45%-3.43%** average reply rates (2025). Searched cold email benchmarks and agency channels.

costs_eat_margin.evidence: After Stripe 2.9% + 30 cents on the full billing and ~3 h of work per order, about **34%** of the $154 commission remains (estimate).

weak_demand.evidence: Searched Collabstr 2025 data and market reports: UGC volume is **rising**; prices are falling, scored under trend.

legal_platform_risk.evidence: Searched FTC rules: the 2023 Endorsement Guides need disclosure and monitoring, which is compliance work, not a blocker.

saturated_wave.evidence: Found **4** brand-creator UGC launches on Product Hunt in 12 months (HourlyUGC, UGCReal, Creator Bridge, MakeUGC workflows), under the 10 threshold.

customer.segment: US Shopify DTC brands under ~$200k/month revenue running paid social
customer.pain: They need a steady flow of fresh creator videos for ads and lack time to recruit and brief creators
customer.today: Billo, Collabstr, TikTok One, Fiverr creators, or AI tools like Arcads
